layout.toggleSidebar: Show or hide the side bar
layout.togglePanel: Show or hide the work panel

errors.invalidCombo: "{{combo}}" is not a valid key combination (action {{action}}).
errors.duplicate: The shortcut {{combo}} is used by "{{action}}" and by "{{other}}".

terminal.cmd: {{combo}} cannot be used in the terminal: it does not send the Cmd key (action {{action}}).
terminal.ctrl_shift_letter: {{combo}} cannot be used in the terminal: Ctrl+Shift+letter reaches the program as Ctrl+letter (action {{action}}).
terminal.bare_printable: {{combo}} cannot be a global shortcut: it would take a character from the text box (action {{action}}).

notices.tmuxPrefix: {{combo}} ("{{action}}") is the default prefix of tmux: press it twice or change the shortcut.
notices.vscodeCapture: {{combo}} ("{{action}}") may be taken by VS Code before it reaches the terminal.
notices.macOption: On macOS, the Alt shortcuts use the Option key: turn on "Use Option as Meta" in the terminal.
notices.macFn: On macOS, the function keys may need the Fn key.

reasons.readline: it is an editing key of the text box and of the shell
reasons.wordJump: it jumps between words in the text box
reasons.flowControl: some terminals use it to pause the output
reasons.tmuxPrefix: it is the prefix of tmux
reasons.browserTab: the browser uses it to close a tab
reasons.terminalAlias: the terminal sends the same code as another key
